description: End-to-end execution governance for Claude Code. Multi-agent pipeline with TDD, adversarial review, 35-gate registry (23 mandatory), glass-box TRACE.md audit trail. v7.2.0 (2026-05-21): Phase 0 hardening — STATE_FILE_INIT_FAIL gate (CIRCUIT_BREAKER hard precondition on initial sentinel-state.json write), PROTOCOL_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT gate (HARD out-of-band timer via SessionStart hook, default 30min configurable), cleanup-orphan-sentinel-state hook (auto-archive of pipeline_active=true state files older than 24h, closes Achado B1-001), --strict-spec flag (rejects Signal 3/4 Spec detection in unattended/CI mode), STRICT_SPEC_REJECTION gate (AUDIT). 4 patches with ATDD/BDD/DDD per batch and adversarial review per batch (22 findings addressed across all batches). v7.1.1 (2026-05-21): docs-only patch. v7.1.0 (2026-05-19): telemetry hygiene.
